subject: Life Skills
title: The Right to Be Forgotten
description: A fast breakdown of The Right to Be Forgotten for builders.

hook.text: In 2014, the EU ruled that people have the right to ask search engines to remove old results.

buildup.text: Before this, embarrassing or outdated information haunted people in search results for decades.

discovery.text: The right to be forgotten balances privacy against the public's right to access information.

twist.text: The data isn't deleted from the source. It's just hidden from search results in specific regions.

climax.text: Many countries now have data deletion laws. You can request companies erase your personal info.

punchline.text: You gave data away. Laws can help you take it back.

quiz.question: What does the 'right to be forgotten' allow?
options: Complete erasure from the entire internet
Removal of links from search engine results
Making your social media completely private
